paragraphs.text: The House of Fentesk is one of the five Houses in Estark , located in Kush , on Dominaria . Its color is orange.

Fentesk's color is orange, and its fighters are generally associated with red and white mana. Before the Time of Troubles , the building of Fentesk was a heavy, squat structure with massive pillars lining its front, with four great banners of solid orange fluttering at the four corners. As of the 998th Festival in 4069 AR , it boasted nearly one hundred fighters, who wore heavily embroidered shirts, loose-fitting silk trousers, calf-high boots, and leather capes trimmed with orange.
Varnel Buckara (from before the Night of Fire until the Time of Troubles )
Alinar : a fighter paired against Ogla of Bolk in the arena.
Haglin : a fighter paired against Erwina of Bolk in the arena.
Okmark : he died in an illegal street duel with Garth One-eye .
Petrakov : a fighter without mercy, who killed both Farnin of Bolk and Farnin's lover.
Varena : one of the House's most elite fighters, who rose to become Grand Master of the Arena after the Time of Troubles
